review_notes: Bangladeshi ordinary passport holders require an entry visa for mainland Vietnam; the electronic visa is available to citizens of all countries and territories. Current 2026 Vietnam National Authority of Tourism guidance states e-Visas are available to all nationalities, up to 90 days, single or multiple entry, USD 25 single-entry and USD 50 multiple-entry, with an indicative 3–5 working-day processing period. The Immigration Department portal confirms the e-Visa is for foreigners outside Vietnam, valid up to 90 days, single or multiple entry, and requires a valid passport. The Vietnam Tourism authority states passport validity of at least six months and two blank pages. The Phu Quoc 30-day exemption is a narrow island-only exception and does not authorize onward travel to mainland Vietnam without a visa. Fee is non-refundable; application and entry remain subject to approval. Checked 2026-11-14.

cross_check_source_name: Maldives Immigration Act 2007 – Section 10 Tourist Visa
review_notes: Maldives Immigration's current tourist visa page, updated 10 September 2026, states that tourist visas are granted on arrival without pre-approval, subject to entry conditions. The official Immigration Act Section 10 provides up to 30 days without payment and allows the Controller discretion to grant up to 90 days after the applicable fee. Required conditions include MRZ passport with at least one month validity, confirmed return journey, prepaid booking at a registered facility, sufficient funds or approved sponsorship, onward-destination eligibility, IMUGA declaration within 96 hours and yellow fever certificate when applicable. Entry remains subject to immigration officer assessment.
